Rich in original detail, this beautifully refreshed three-bedroom, two-bathroom home welcomes you with gorgeous refinished original hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and a warm, inviting ambiance throughout. The thoughtfully designed interior features smart locks on all exterior doors turning your cell phone into keys, never carry keys again!
